on_select.condition: not v.hookHandled and (v.combatState == 'log' or v.combatState == 'victory' or v.combatState == 'levelup')

scripts.announceLevelUp:
local v = ctx.v
if v.combatState ~= "levelup" or v.levelUpIndex == v.announcedLevelUpIndex then return end
v.announcedLevelUpIndex = v.levelUpIndex
v.eventsQueue = v.eventsQueue or {}
v.eventQueueIndex = #v.eventsQueue + 1
table.insert(v.eventsQueue, { type = "text", text = tostring(v.levelUpName or "A creature") .. " has leveled up!" })
v.pendingLevelUpLog = true
v.combatState = "log"
api.battle.advanceLog()
v.hookHandled = true
scripts.handleInput:
local v = ctx.v
local b = v.battle

if v.confirmPhase then
    if v.action == "up" or v.action == "left" or v.action == "down" or v.action == "right" then
        v.selectedIndex = (v.selectedIndex % 2) + 1
    elseif v.action == "cancel" then
        api.battle.undoAction()
    elseif v.action == "select" then
        if v.selectedIndex == 1 then
            api.battle.submitRound()
        else
            api.battle.undoAction()
        end
    end
    return
end

local memberInfo = (v.livingMembers or {})[v.activeMemberIdx or 1]
if not memberInfo then
    v.combatState = "log"
    return
end

if v.inspectingTarget then
    if v.action == "cancel" or v.action == "inspect" then
        v.inspectingTarget = false
    elseif v.action == "up" then
        v.inspectStateIdx = math.max(1, (v.inspectStateIdx or 1) - 1)
    elseif v.action == "down" then
        -- we don't know the exact max here without re-evaluating the target,
        -- but the renderer clamps it so we can just increment.
        v.inspectStateIdx = (v.inspectStateIdx or 1) + 1
    end
    return
end

if v.targetSelect then
    local targeting = api.targeting
    local candidates = targeting.getCandidates(memberInfo.actor, v.pendingAction.targetSpec, b)
    if v.action == "up" or v.action == "left" then
        if #candidates > 0 then v.targetIndex = (v.targetIndex - 2) % #candidates + 1 end
    elseif v.action == "down" or v.action == "right" then
        if #candidates > 0 then v.targetIndex = v.targetIndex % #candidates + 1 end
    elseif v.action == "inspect" then
        v.inspectingTarget = true
    elseif v.action == "cancel" then
        v.targetSelect = false
        v.selectedIndex = v.prevSelectedIndex or 1
    elseif v.action == "select" then
        if #candidates > 0 then
            local chosenTarget = candidates[v.targetIndex]
            v.targetSelect = false
            api.battle.commitAction(memberInfo.index, { type = v.pendingAction.type, id = v.pendingAction.id, itemIndex = v.pendingAction.itemIndex, target = chosenTarget })
        end
    end
    return
end

if v.skillSelect then
    local options = {}
    for _, skId in ipairs(memberInfo.actor.skills or {}) do
        local sk = api.getSkill(skId)
        if sk then table.insert(options, sk) end
    end

    if v.action == "up" then
        if #options > 0 then v.selectedIndex = (v.selectedIndex - 2) % #options + 1 end
    elseif v.action == "down" then
        if #options > 0 then v.selectedIndex = v.selectedIndex % #options + 1 end
    elseif v.action == "cancel" then
        v.skillSelect = false
        v.selectedIndex = v.submenuReturnIndex or 1
    elseif v.action == "select" then
        local choice = options[v.selectedIndex]
        if choice then
            -- The gate is enforced HERE as well as greyed in the list: the row
            -- is still selectable so the player can read why, but committing
            -- it says no and explains, rather than silently doing nothing.
            local info = api.skillCost(memberInfo.actor, choice.id)
            if info.blocked then
                api.battle.showMessage(choice.name .. ": " .. (info.reason or "Unavailable"))
            else
                api.battle.startTargetSelection({ type = "skill", id = choice.id })
            end
        end
    end
elseif v.itemSelect then
    local items = api.items()
    if v.action == "up" then
        if #items > 0 then v.selectedIndex = (v.selectedIndex - 2) % #items + 1 end
    elseif v.action == "down" then
        if #items > 0 then v.selectedIndex = v.selectedIndex % #items + 1 end
    elseif v.action == "cancel" then
        v.itemSelect = false
        v.selectedIndex = v.submenuReturnIndex or 1
    elseif v.action == "select" then
        local choice = items[v.selectedIndex]
        if choice then
            api.battle.startTargetSelection({ type = "item", id = choice.id, itemIndex = v.selectedIndex })
        end
    end
else
    -- Dispatch on the command's id, never on the row number: with the set
    -- authored per creature, row 3 is Defend for a Pixie and does not exist
    -- for an Egg. Wrapping counts the rows this creature actually has.
    local cmds = api.battleCommands(memberInfo.actor)
    local n = #cmds
    if v.action == "left" or v.action == "up" then
        if n > 0 then v.selectedIndex = (v.selectedIndex - 2) % n + 1 end
    elseif v.action == "right" or v.action == "down" then
        if n > 0 then v.selectedIndex = v.selectedIndex % n + 1 end
    elseif v.action == "cancel" then
        api.battle.undoAction()
    elseif v.action == "select" then
        local cmd = cmds[v.selectedIndex]
        if cmd then
            if cmd.resolve == "target" then
                api.battle.startTargetSelection(cmd.action or { type = cmd.id })
            elseif cmd.resolve == "submenu" then
                -- Remember the row to come back to, rather than the magic 2/4
                -- the cancel branches used to hardcode.
                v.submenuReturnIndex = v.selectedIndex
                if cmd.submenu == "skill" then v.skillSelect = true
                elseif cmd.submenu == "item" then v.itemSelect = true end
                v.selectedIndex = 1
            elseif cmd.resolve == "commit" then
                local act = { type = cmd.id }
                if cmd.action then
                    act = { type = cmd.action.type, id = cmd.action.id }
                    -- A committed action carries its target object. Only "self"
                    -- is resolvable without asking the player, which is exactly
                    -- what a command that skips target selection needs.
                    if cmd.action.target == "self" then act.target = memberInfo.actor end
                end
                api.battle.commitAction(memberInfo.index, act)
            end
        end
    end
end
scripts.handleLogInput:
local v = ctx.v
if v.action == "select" then
    if api.battle.isLogRevealing() then
        api.battle.finishLogReveal()
        v.hookHandled = true
    elseif api.battle.isAnimationPlaying() then
        v.hookHandled = true
    elseif v.eventQueueIndex <= #(v.eventsQueue or {}) then
        api.battle.advanceLog()
        -- Reward and level-up narration share their matching window. The
        -- confirm that advances beyond a fully-read line starts that beat.
        if v.pendingRewardLog and v.eventQueueIndex > #(v.eventsQueue or {}) then
            v.pendingRewardLog = nil
            v.combatState = "victory"
            v.victoryStage = 1
        elseif v.pendingLevelUpLog and v.eventQueueIndex > #(v.eventsQueue or {}) then
            v.pendingLevelUpLog = nil
            v.combatState = "levelup"
        end
        v.hookHandled = true
    else
        v.hookHandled = false
    end
else
    v.hookHandled = false
end
scripts.handleTransition:
local v = ctx.v
if v.action ~= "select" or not v.battle then
    v.hookHandled = false
    return
end

-- A reward log line and its matching window are one presentation beat. Once
-- the line is read, leave the window in place and start its drain animation;
-- no information is presented a second time.
if v.combatState == "log" and v.pendingRewardLog
    and v.eventQueueIndex > #(v.eventsQueue or {}) then
    v.pendingRewardLog = nil
    v.combatState = "victory"
    v.victoryStage = 1
    v.hookHandled = true
    return
end

-- Gold/items precede EXP. After Gold finishes draining, open the EXP window
-- at the same moment its ordinary typewriter console line begins revealing.
if v.combatState == "victory" and v.rewardPresentationStage == "spoils" then
    if v.victoryStage == 0 then
        v.victoryStage = 1
    elseif v.victoryStage == 2 then
        v.rewardPresentationStage = "exp"
        v.victoryStage = 0
        v.eventsQueue = v.eventsQueue or {}
        v.eventQueueIndex = #v.eventsQueue + 1
        local reward = v.victory or {}
        table.insert(v.eventsQueue, { type = "text", text = "Earned " .. tostring(reward.exp or 0) .. " Experience Points." })
        v.pendingRewardLog = "exp"
        v.combatState = "log"
        api.battle.advanceLog()
    end
    v.hookHandled = true
    return
end

local before = v.combatState
v.hookHandled = api.battle.handleTransition(v.action)
if before == "log" and v.combatState == "victory" and not v.rewardAnnounced then
    v.rewardAnnounced = true
    v.rewardPresentationStage = "spoils"
    v.victoryStage = 0
    v.eventsQueue = v.eventsQueue or {}
    v.eventQueueIndex = #v.eventsQueue + 1
    local reward = v.victory or {}
    table.insert(v.eventsQueue, { type = "text", text = "Found " .. tostring(reward.gold or 0) .. " Gold." })
    v.pendingRewardLog = "spoils"
    v.combatState = "log"
    api.battle.advanceLog()
    v.hookHandled = true
end
scripts.refreshConsole:
local v = ctx.v
local memberInfo = (v.livingMembers or {})[v.activeMemberIdx or 1]
local monster = memberInfo and memberInfo.actor
local rows, helps = {}, {}
if v.confirmPhase then
    table.insert(rows, { name = "Execute Round" })
    table.insert(rows, { name = "Back" })
    helps[1] = "Execute all queued party actions for this round."
    helps[2] = "Go back to modify queued actions."
elseif v.skillSelect then
    -- A known skill is never hidden: an unusable one is shown greyed with its
    -- cost still legible and the reason in the context-help bar. A row that
    -- vanishes looks like a bug and teaches the player nothing.
    for _, skId in ipairs((monster and monster.skills) or {}) do
        local sk = api.getSkill(skId)
        if sk then
            local info = api.skillCost(monster, skId)
            table.insert(rows, { name = sk.name, icon = sk.icon or 0,
                costSegments = info.cost, disabled = info.blocked })
            table.insert(helps, info.blocked
                and ((info.reason or "Unavailable") .. " -- " .. (sk.description or ""))
                or (sk.description or ""))
        end
    end
    if #rows == 0 then table.insert(rows, { name = "(No skills)" }) end
elseif v.itemSelect then
    local pending = {}
    for _, mInfo in ipairs(v.livingMembers or {}) do
        local act = v.pendingActions and v.pendingActions[mInfo.index]
        if act and act.type == "item" and (act.id or act.itemId) then
            local itemId = act.id or act.itemId
            pending[itemId] = (pending[itemId] or 0) + 1
        end
    end
    for _, it in ipairs(api.items()) do
        local full = api.getItem(it.id)
        local queuedCount = pending[it.id] or 0
        local availQty = math.max(0, it.qty - queuedCount)
        local label = (it.name or "?") .. " x" .. tostring(availQty)
        if queuedCount > 0 then
            label = label .. " [" .. queuedCount .. " pending]"
        end
        table.insert(rows, { name = label, icon = (full and full.icon) or it.icon or 0 })
        table.insert(helps, (full and full.description) or "")
    end
    if #rows == 0 then table.insert(rows, { name = "(No items)" }) end
else
    -- The command set is this creature's, not a fixed five: engine.json
    -- `battleCommands` filtered by the actor's own list. An Egg shows one row.
    v.commandIds = {}
    for i, cmd in ipairs(api.battleCommands(monster)) do
        table.insert(rows, { name = cmd.label or cmd.id })
        helps[i] = cmd.help or ""
        v.commandIds[i] = cmd.id
    end
end
v.commandRows = rows
v.currentHelpText = helps[v.selectedIndex] or ""

windows.visible: v._dockContentReady ~= false and v.combatState == 'input' and not v.targetSelect and not v.skillSelect and not v.itemSelect
v._dockContentReady ~= false and v.combatState == 'input' and not v.targetSelect and v.skillSelect == true
v._dockContentReady ~= false and v.combatState == 'input' and not v.targetSelect and v.itemSelect == true
v._dockContentReady ~= false and v.combatState == 'input' and v.targetSelect == true and not v.inspectingTarget
v._dockContentReady ~= false and v.combatState == 'input' and v.targetSelect == true and v.inspectingTarget == true
windows.title: Battler Info

windows.visible: v.combatState == 'log' or (v.combatState == 'victory' and v.rewardPresentationStage ~= nil) or v.combatState == 'levelup'

dock.cursor: v.combatState == 'input' and (v.livingMembers and v.livingMembers[v.activeMemberIdx or 1] and v.livingMembers[v.activeMemberIdx or 1].index or 0) or 0
